name: reelsy-video
description: Create Canvas-visible Reelsy video assets and edit confirmed projects through the production OAuth MCP and Hosted OpenCut.

interface.shortDescription: Create and edit Reelsy videos from ChatGPT
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to owner-scoped Reelsy projects through the production OAuth MCP. Show generated clips on the Canvas by default, and use Hosted OpenCut only when the user requests or confirms editing, combination, or export preparation. OpenCut browser exports remain local and do not create Canvas Final Artifacts.
